# Correct heterosite Reich2024 methods locator

The frozen owner `data/records/heterosite.yaml` describes the complete Reich, Eiche & Kolb (2024), DOI 10.1016/j.desal.2024.117883 original as having “methods sections 2.1–2.3”. PDF page 3 actually contains section 2 Materials and methods and only subsection 2.1 Experimental, then section 3 Results.

Independent native initial: `reviews/structured/20261015T125439Z-heterosite-round95-initial-locator/review.yaml`, F1, stable key `heterosite-round95-methods-section-locator`. Original owner SHA256 `ab138bec6a2ec7951640720e6063b42ea253c92409fca4a64cf9b350343c87d4`; complete primary SHA256 `26a6095b8aef3e0e8ea227dcd3a08b7772de169695b423d5a52d36c91b156286`.

Acceptance: correct only this source locator; preserve supported experiments/denominators and immutable CREATE/initial review; append actual EDIT provenance, validate final bytes and save a successor explicitly resolving F1. Current batch is running against unchanged original inputs; correction waits its terminal receipt.
